scope: Read-only recovery assessment of P1 event integration and RX baseline interpretation; no production data or code modified and no hardware accessed.

e79_esp32_raw_coverage.note: Coverage is file presence. Exhaustive gzip integrity is audited separately by Tesla. All accepted RX packet rows were successful. One accepted TX 64-byte IEEE154G50/-20 dBm repetition has rx_missing, retained as observed loss.

methods: Decompress full gzip and parse every CSV sample and trigger marker.
Reintegrate original summary window; original total energies reproduced.
For TX E79, identify high-charge pulse groups and inspect cadence, expected frame count, and quiet tail.
For RX, do not interpret threshold/noise groups as frame boundaries; combine retained sample span with acquisition control flow and received-payload evidence.

software_reanalysis.recommendation: Prioritize reanalysis of retained complete traces, rather than physically repeating the archived campaigns solely because P1 exists.
software_reanalysis.e79_fragmented_tx: Raw samples contain the omitted transmissions in the checked fast, slow, high-power and low-power examples. Integrate all frame windows, or a declared full transaction window including gaps, and regenerate derived reports.
software_reanalysis.packet_rx: Reanalysis over a declared receive-workload window is possible from retained raw traces. Correct omitted inter-frame and host-command delays. Whole transaction boundaries are not automatically identifiable in a nearly flat RX-current waveform.
software_reanalysis.acquisition_contract: runner._execute_receive_transfer completes transmission and receiver draining within the trigger callback. Ppk2Sampler.capture requires callback termination, reads final PPK data, and then stops measurement. A successful saved RX capture therefore spans the callback's receptions; individual lost PPK samples remain a separate sample-loss limitation.
software_reanalysis.not_done: This audit does not choose a new scientific integration definition and does not publish corrected campaign energies. Representative checks are not an exhaustive reconstruction of every packet.

baseline.current_mean_total_power: Existing continuous mean current and total power do not require repetition merely because the baseline was labeled standby.
baseline.rename: For RX sessions whose receiver is enabled before pre-trigger, label baseline as RX idle/listening before traffic, not standby. Corresponding excess is above that state.
baseline.standby_option: If a true standby-referenced quantity is wanted, acquire a separate controlled standby baseline at matching module, voltage, radio configuration and conditions. Repeating every 60-second traffic window is not automatically necessary.
baseline.full_startup_option: If the desired packet quantity is exact standby-to-RX-to-standby transaction energy, acquire new synchronized traces with receiver-state transitions and per-frame/RF markers inside the capture. Existing traces begin after RX enable and end before RX disable, so missing startup/shutdown energy and exact flat-waveform boundaries cannot be recovered from those files.

physical_recapture_recommendation: No additional mandatory physical recapture was demonstrated by these eight complete traces. Recapture is needed for genuinely missing/unrecoverable authoritative raw files when exact reanalysis is required, or for newly requested standby/startup/synchronized timing measurements. Missing-file and full-integrity inventories are produced separately by root/Faraday/Tesla.
